build_itpn_decoder: build an iTPNPretrainDecoder module with pixel reconstruction type and default transformer pyramid network settings
build_patch_split: build a PatchSplit upsampling module to reshape and upsample transformer patch features by 2x spatial resolution
build_transformer_pyramid: build a transformer pyramid network with configurable FPN depth and multi-scale feature alignment layers
init_decoder_weights: initialize the iTPN decoder position embeddings with 2D sincos and mask tokens with normal distribution
forward_itpn_decoder: run the iTPN decoder forward pass to reconstruct pixel features from encoder hidden states and mask restore ids
